title: Rexona 'Armband Pressure' Viral Reactive

rationale: High organic momentum with over 2.4M live impressions in the last 2 hours. Fast, low-cost reactive play to capitalize on earned media.

title: Dove 'Code of Real Beauty' Anti-AI Filter Campaign
creativeAngle: Partnership with 25 authentic beauty creators pledging zero digital retouching and demonstrating how AI image generators create distorted beauty standards.
rationale: Directly reinforces Dove's 20-year Real Beauty equity amidst mounting consumer anxiety over generative AI aesthetics.

title: Knorr Ramadan '15-Minute Iftar Nourish' Hacks
creativeAngle: High-speed video series with local creators creating comforting, nutrient-dense Iftar soups and stews in under 15 minutes during fasting month.
rationale: Peak Ramadan grocery search volume (+340% for quick meal ideas) makes this a high-conversion, low-risk seasonal opportunity.

title: Magnum Couture Dipping Bar Street Pop-Up
creativeAngle: Luxury street pop-up in high-fashion districts offering bespoke gold leaf and ruby chocolate dipped Magnum bars co-hosted by fashion week creators.
rationale: Amplifies Magnum's premium indulgence positioning and drives high-aesthetic user-generated content (UGC) ripple across social feeds.

title: Hellmann's 'Leftover Playbook' Super Bowl Reactive
creativeAngle: Humorous multi-channel push showing game day hosts turning cold buffalo wings and stale pizza crusts into gourmet dips with Hellmann's mayo.
rationale: Post-game day food waste is at an annual peak. Ties national sports excitement directly to Hellmann's 'Make Taste, Not Waste' mission.
